candidate.title: SIDR
candidate.scope: The assigned SIDR row of the Illumina Integrated Techniques schematic, from cell-surface microbead binding before lysis to separate sequencing-ready libraries derived from cellular mRNA and genomic DNA. The single-cell Total RNA/DNA icons at left summarize analytes; they do not depict a physical split before bead binding. The lower, partially visible DR-Seq row is an independently labeled neighboring assay, not an explicitly linked alternative target. The paper identifies parallel sequencing after SIDR isolation as SIDR-seq/scSIDR-seq; this is the sequencing implementation clarified here, not another target name. Broad library-preparation arrows are retained as separate local RNA and DNA operations, without reconstructing their internal protocols.
